name: MITF-M melanocyte program for pigment production
rationale: All members concern the MITF-M-driven melanocyte program (differentiation, proliferation, invasion, metabolism, lysosomes); unlike confusables it includes melanin synthesis, pigment granule localization, OCA6 and UV/blue-light responses.

name: Epithelial salt and water homeostasis under osmotic stress
rationale: Members cover sodium, potassium and chloride transport (cation-chloride cotransporter diseases, renal sodium transport) and cell water balance; the hyperosmotic, salt-stress and osmosensory responses distinguish it from confusables focused on aldosterone or P-type ATPase gradients.

name: ER entry and COPII exit of membrane proteins
rationale: Members span SRP-dependent and tail-anchored insertion into the ER membrane, ER retention and COPII cargo export; confusables instead emphasize ER folding, ERAD or COPI retrograde traffic.

name: Sarcoplasmic reticulum calcium cycling via SERCA regulation
rationale: Members regulate calcium release from and reuptake into the SR/ER and lowering of cytosolic calcium; regulation of ATPase-coupled calcium import into the SR (and caffeine response) distinguishes it from cardiac-contraction confusables.

name: Transcriptional control of erythroid differentiation
rationale: Members describe erythroid commitment and terminal red cell differentiation with transcriptional regulators (TAL1-GFI1B, ATF signaling); confusables instead carry megakaryocyte or stem-cell/primitive-definitive hematopoiesis.

name: Urea cycle citrulline synthesis by ornithine transcarbamylase
rationale: All members concern citrulline/arginine synthesis in the urea cycle and OTC deficiency variants, whereas confusables hold other urea-cycle enzyme defects or ornithine/ammonium handling.

core: Antimicrobial defense against fungi and bacteria
name: Antifungal and antibacterial defense via cytolytic killing
rationale: Members cover killing of microbes (antifungal humoral response, Gram-positive defense, metal sequestration, cytolysis, neutrophil cytotoxicity); regulation of direct killing distinguishes it from degranulation, respiratory burst and mucosal agglutination confusables.

name: Glucose storage as glycogen and hexose transport
rationale: Members cover glycogen synthesis/breakdown and storage diseases plus intestinal and renal hexose absorption and transport; glycogen handling separates it from glycolysis/gluconeogenesis and galactose/urate confusables.

name: TGF-beta superfamily SMAD signaling including cancer mutants
rationale: Members cover TGF-beta, BMP, activin and AMH receptor-SMAD signaling and its regulators; receptor/SMAD cancer mutants and RUNX3 targets distinguish it from the nearest confusable.

name: Proximal TCR and BCR signaling with co-receptor tuning
rationale: Members concern antigen receptor proximal signaling in T and B cells with CD28, CTLA4, BTLA, CD22 and PECAM1 co-receptor control; BCR signaling distinguishes it from T-cell-only confusables.

name: Plasma membrane solute carrier transport of amino acids
rationale: Members are plasma membrane SLC transport processes and their diseases, dominated by amino acid and oligopeptide carriers; these distinguish it from organic cation, hexose and cationic amino acid confusables.

name: Vascular remodeling via endothelial and smooth muscle cells
rationale: Members regulate angiogenesis (VEGF, Tie2, sprouting) and vascular smooth muscle proliferation, migration and phenotypic switching; the smooth muscle arm separates it from the closest confusable, the VEGF arm from the others.

name: Amino acid catabolism including tyrosine degradation
rationale: Members cover amino acid metabolism (proline, glycine, glyoxylate, phenylalanine); tyrosine catabolism distinguishes it from threonine/organic-acid confusables.

name: Osteoblast differentiation controlled by Wnt and mechanical load
rationale: Members regulate mesenchymal progenitor and osteoblast proliferation/differentiation via RUNX2, Wnt, BMP; Wnt antagonism and PIEZO1 mechanical signaling distinguish it from osteoclast, collagen and chondrocyte confusables.

name: B cell development and activation via BCR signaling
rationale: Members cover B cell development, proliferation, homeostasis and activation; BCR signaling events (RAS activation, CD22, BTK) distinguish it from plasma/memory/germinal-center confusables.

name: MECP2 neuronal gene repression via HDAC corepressors
rationale: Members center on MECP2 regulation of neuronal genes and Rett-type loss-of-function plus related sensory phenotypes; HDAC/NCoR repression and translational repression distinguish it from behavior-focused confusables.

name: RNA polymerase II transcription regulation including termination
rationale: Members regulate Pol II transcription from preinitiation to elongation; termination control and R-loop processing distinguish it from elongation-complex and RNA processing confusables.

name: Sarcoplasmic calcium cycling restraining cardiac contraction
rationale: Members regulate SR calcium release (ryanodine receptor) and cytosolic calcium clearance in muscle; negative regulation of cardiac contraction and heart rate distinguishes it from SERCA-centred and positive-inotropy confusables.

name: p53 transcriptional induction of apoptosis
rationale: Members concern p53 transcription of apoptotic genes and BH3-only PUMA/NOXA-driven cytochrome c release; the transcriptional targets distinguish it from BAX/BAK and GO-only p53 confusables.

name: Ovarian cycle from follicle growth to luteolysis
rationale: Members cover follicle development, oocyte maturation, ovulation, luteinization and luteolysis; ovarian-intrinsic events distinguish it from gonadotropin-response confusables.

name: Plasma membrane amino acid transport incl. Hartnup disorder
rationale: Members are plasma membrane amino acid transport processes and transporter defects; SLC6A19 Hartnup, SLC6A14 and SLC1A1 distinguish it from iminoglycinuria-centred confusables.

name: Centrosome-anchored microtubule organization for spindle orientation
rationale: Members concern centrosome positioning, microtubule nucleation/anchoring and cortical cues; spindle orientation and asymmetric division distinguish it from mitotic-centrosome, cytokinesis and centriole-duplication confusables.

name: Plasma membrane protein delivery via endocytic recycling
rationale: Members regulate endosome-to-plasma membrane recycling, endosome organization and constitutive secretion; recycling distinguishes it from Golgi-endosome-lysosome traffic confusables.

name: Cardiac muscle growth and adaptation, including contractility
rationale: Members regulate cardiomyocyte proliferation, growth, hypertrophy and regeneration; heart rate and contraction force distinguish it from the calcineurin-focused confusable and from smooth muscle confusables.

name: Golgi structural organization and membrane tubulation
rationale: Members concern Golgi ribbon assembly, disassembly, positioning and budding; membrane tubulation distinguishes it from COPI traffic and secretion confusables.

name: DNA base damage repair including alkylation reversal
rationale: Members cover base excision repair and its glycosylase defects; direct alkylation reversal (ALKBH2/3, MGMT) distinguishes it from mismatch repair and crosslink confusables.

name: RHO and CDC42 GTPase cycles
rationale: Members are Rho-family GTPase cycles and effector signaling; RHOA/B/C, CDC42 and formins distinguish it from RAC-, RND- or IQGAP-centred confusables.

name: Bilirubin production and hepatic clearance
rationale: Members cover heme degradation, hepatic bilirubin uptake (SLCO), conjugation (UGT1A) and export (ABCC2) with their hyperbilirubinemias, distinguishing it from drug ADME confusables.

name: Proline and glycine transporter defects causing iminoglycinuria
rationale: All three members are SLC6A20/SLC36A2 defects causing iminoglycinuria and hyperglycinuria, absent from all confusables.

name: Cerebellar and striatal motor coordination and learning
rationale: Members cover locomotion, proprioception, righting reflex, motor learning and cerebellar/striatal formation; cerebellar layer formation and motor learning distinguish it from vocal and sensory behavior confusables.
